guide.title: LEAVE ALIVE.
guide.1: WASD / arrows to move. Shift to sprint. E to interact. After exhaustion, recover 30% stamina before sprinting again.
guide.2: F repels with a flash. R drops a decoy. Q heals 40 health. You can also click item icons. Matching keys are consumed on first unlock.
guide.3: T toggles the flashlight. A full charge lasts 120 seconds outside the tutorial. Switching off or hiding stops battery drain.
guide.4: Searching raises danger. The final fuse starts an 8-second power sequence. Keep moving. Use F to stop the crying patient’s lunge.
guide.5: Cross-marked cabinets contain supplies. Tall lockers hide you for up to 8 seconds. Break line of sight before hiding.
tutorial.exitText: All three fuses are collected. This green-lit door is your exit. The {seconds, number}-second power countdown resumes when the camera returns. Keep moving, then come here and press E to escape.
tutorial.healthText: The white bar at the upper left is your health. Hits shorten it; at zero, you die. Blinking after a hit gives brief protection. Press Q to heal 40 health with a bandage.
tutorial.flashlightText: The upper-right flashlight shows battery charge and time, separately from health. Press T or click its icon. Try switching off, then on. Switching off or hiding stops battery drain; use the beam to see ahead.
tutorial.monster-listenerText: It cannot see you. Sprinting, searching boxes and using doors reveal your position. Walk away from the sound or press R to distract it. Do not stay where it is searching.
tutorial.monster-light-shyTitle: Light-Shy · Flash your beam, then run
tutorial.monster-light-shyText: Catch it in your beam to make it recoil. Turn away and run: it cowers for about 2 more seconds. It lowers its arms before chasing again. Repeated light hits cannot extend this window during cooldown. Press F for a longer escape window.
tutorial.monster-patrollerTitle: Patroller · Turn a corner and close the door
tutorial.monster-patrollerText: It pursues you on sight. Turn a corner and press E to close a door behind you. Break line of sight before hiding.
tutorial.monster-weeperTitle: Crying Patient · Do not disturb it
tutorial.monster-weeperText: Press T to turn off your light. Walk quietly and keep your distance. Nearby light, sprinting and noise provoke it. Once it stands, it hunts until it kills you or a flash stops it. Missing, darkness and hiding will not end the hunt. Press F to stop it; dodging only avoids one lunge.
ui.wasd-arrows-to-move-shift-to-sprint: WASD / arrows to move. Shift to sprint. E to pick up, search and operate doors. After exhaustion, recover 30% stamina before sprinting again.
ui.f-repels-nearby-monsters-r-drops-a: F repels nearby monsters. R drops a decoy; move away afterwards. Q heals 40 health. Item icons can also be clicked. Keys unlock matching doors or boxes and are consumed on first use.
ui.t-or-the-battery-icon-toggles-the: T or the battery icon toggles the flashlight. A full charge lasts 120 seconds outside the tutorial. Switching off or hiding stops drain. Use fixed lights to search and your beam to see ahead.
ui.searching-raises-danger-the-final-fus: Searching raises danger. The final fuse starts an 8-second power sequence; keep moving until escape is possible. Distance loses the Listener. Light repels the Light-Shy. Walls, furniture and closed doors block monsters.
ui.from-stage-carry-one-flash-decoy-and: From stage 2, carry one flash, decoy and bandage; supply stages add one flash. Press E at a cross-marked cabinet for supplies, or at a tall locker to hide for up to 8 seconds. Break line of sight first. Ordinary furniture is only scenery and cover.

gameplay.stage-brass-keys-open-brass-box: Stage {stage} · {area}. Brass keys open brass boxes. The unlocked box holds a ward key; the brass box holds a sealed-box key. Keys are consumed on first unlock. Collect 3 fuses, then press E at EXIT. F repels and stuns for {stunSeconds} seconds, plus 2 seconds against the Light-Shy. R distracts for {decoySeconds} seconds. Q heals. T toggles the flashlight. Use F to stop a lunging patient. Sprint with Shift; after exhaustion, recover 30% stamina. Searching raises danger. The final fuse starts exit power; keep moving while waiting. Items refill each stage.
gameplay.it-cannot-see-sprinting-and-sea: It cannot see. Sprinting and searching reveal you. Walk away or distract it with R
gameplay.light-makes-it-recoil-turn-and-: Light makes it recoil. Turn and run; repeated light cannot immediately suppress it again
gameplay.it-pursues-on-sight-turn-corner: It pursues on sight. Turn corners and close doors with E; distract it nearby with R
gameplay.extra-supplies-one-additional-f: Extra supplies: one additional flash per stage

lesson.first-rule-of-the-night-shift: First rule of the night shift
lesson.move-with-wasd-arrows-hold-shift-: Move with WASD / arrows. Hold Shift for a short sprint; release it to recover stamina. Walk along the corridor first.
lesson.approach-the-brass-key-on-the-flo: Approach the brass key on the floor and press E. Special keys fit matching locks and are consumed on first use.
lesson.approach-a-box-and-press-e-to: Approach a box and press E to search. After taking the fuse, prepare for whatever the noise attracts.
lesson.do-not-let-it-get-closer: Do not let it get closer
lesson.it-is-within-flash-range-press-f: It is within flash range. Press F or click the flash device to repel and stun it, then leave.
lesson.press-r-or-click-the-decoy-to: Press R or click the decoy to leave a sound at your feet. Walk away and let the monster follow the decoy.
lesson.press-q-or-click-the-bandage-to: Press Q or click the bandage to restore 40 health. Check that health has recovered to finish the lesson.
lesson.you-are-unhurt-simulate-a-minor-i: You are unhurt. Simulate a minor injury of 20 health and bandage with Q, or skip and learn when actually injured.
lesson.approach-the-room-door-and-press-: Approach the room door and press E to unlock. Unlocked doors can be opened and closed repeatedly. Closed doors block monsters.
key.blueObtained: Brass key consumed; blue sealed-box key obtained.
event.plant: The power relay trips. Emergency lights take over.
event.ward: That disconnected monitor just lit up.
event.warehouse: A sound behind the shelves. The aisle lights dim.
command.supply.description: Replenish the least-stocked item from stage 2. Aid has a cooldown
command.repel.description: Suppress a nearby crying patient for 6 seconds and repel pursuers. Cannot pass through walls
command.blackout.description: Turn off ambient lights for 5 seconds. The flashlight still works. Cooldown after recovery; effects do not stack.
command.ghost.description: Pursuit begins after a 3-second warning. Counter it with flashes and decoys.
command.drain.description: Extra battery drain for 8 seconds, losing at most 16%. Duration does not stack.
command.alarm.description: Expose your position for 6 seconds. Press R to distract with a decoy.
note.3: An empty waiting hall. A sound behind a clinic door.
note.4: The operating light is still on.
